title: reviewDeployment
responsibility: Builds a short-lived deployment plan with target identity, immutable source, predecessor proof and blockers.

inputs.name: reviewDeployment.root
inputs.description: Repository directory for the Git reads (`git -C root`), passed to `options.plugin.discover` and returned unchanged as `root`. reviewDeployment does not check that it is a Git repository, so a directory outside one makes the Git reads reject.

inputs.name: reviewDeployment.input
inputs.description: Requested `environment` (dev, stage, preprod or prod), which selects the target, the predecessor and the plan environment, and the source `commit`, which becomes the plan commit unless a prod promotion supplies a preprod receipt. When `deploymentBlockers` takes its non-prod path, the plan gets a blocker if HEAD differs from `commit` or the current branch differs from the discovered `sourceBranch`; the optional `projectId` is unused here, and the result's `projectId` comes from `options.projectId`.

inputs.name: reviewDeployment.options
inputs.type: { plugin: DeploymentPlugin; projectId: string | null; queuedChange?: boolean }
inputs.description: Adapter and project identity: `plugin.discover(root)` supplies the configuration, `plugin.id` becomes `plan.adapter`, and `projectId` is copied unchanged to the result. When `queuedChange` is true, `deploymentBlockers` runs with environment `dev` instead of `input.environment`, while the target, predecessor and plan environment still use `input.environment`.

outputs.name: reviewDeployment
outputs.description: Resolves to the reviewed plan, which expires five minutes after review and lists its blockers, with `sourceEnvironment` (the previous configured environment, or null), `root`, `projectId` and `fingerprint` (SHA-256 hex of the discovered configuration's JSON). `target` is undefined when the environment has no configured target, and `predecessor` is the preprod receipt for a prod promotion, otherwise the stored receipt for `sourceEnvironment`, or null.

plan.target: pages · harness-docs · main · account e41d7a0c3b9f52e8a6d1c4f0b7e3a9d2 · https://docs.example.com/health

errors.name: DeploymentPlugin.discover rejection
errors.description: Rejects with whatever `options.plugin.discover(root)` rejects with, passed through unchanged; the DeploymentPlugin type does not define those errors.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with the error from a git read that exits non-zero (for example when `root` is not a Git repository or has no commits), or with a filesystem error other than ENOENT while reading receipts.json.

errors.name: ZodError
errors.description: Rejects when `harness-deployments/receipts.json` under the Git common directory is valid JSON that does not match the receipt schema, for example a commit that is not 40 to 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters; deploymentState rethrows it.

errors.name: SyntaxError
errors.description: Rejects when `harness-deployments/receipts.json` under the Git common directory is not valid JSON; deploymentState rethrows it.
